source.author: verg
source.text: Atque hic successu exsultans animisque Coroebus, O socii, qua prima inquit fortuna salutis monstrat iter, quoque ostendit se dextra, sequamur mutemus clipeos, Danaumque insignia nobis aptemus: dolus an virtus, quis in hoste requirat?
source.text_original: Atque hic successu exsultans animisque Coroebus, / 'O socii, qua prima' inquit 'fortuna salutis / monstrat iter, quoque ostendit se dextra, sequamur / mutemus clipeos, Danaumque insignia nobis / aptemus: dolus an virtus, quis in hoste requirat?
source.text_english: Then here Coroebus, exulting in success and in spirit, said: O comrades, where fortune first shows the path to safety and where she points the way with her right hand, let us follow and change our shields, and adapt the insignia of the Danaans to ourselves. Whether it is trickery or courage—who among enemies would inquire?

reuse.author: hier

reuse.text_original: dolus, an virtus, quis in hoste requirat?
reuse.text_english: Whether one seeks guile or valor in an enemy, who asks?
